hero.title: Got a suspicious message? Upload the screenshot.
hero.subtitle: AI reads and explains. Deterministic rules and live security verifiers decide the risk.

form.dragDrop: Drag and drop screenshot here, or click to browse
form.pasteClipboardHint: You can also press Ctrl+V to paste a screenshot directly from your clipboard.
form.fileHint: Supports PNG, JPEG, and WebP up to 8 MB. Processed in-memory, never stored.
form.invalidFileType: Please upload a valid image file (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).
form.fileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum allowed size is 8 MB.
form.emptyInput: Please select a screenshot or paste text before analyzing.
form.textPlaceholder: Paste the suspicious WhatsApp message, SMS alert, email text, or payment note here...
form.modeCloudTooltip: Fast inference with live Google Safe Browsing and URLhaus domain verifications under zero-data-retention.
form.modeLocalTooltip: Runs on your local Ollama daemon. No data ever leaves your computer or local network.
form.noStorageNote: We don't store your image. Uploads are processed in RAM and cleared immediately.

results.title: Analysis Result
results.bandLow: No major red flags found, still verify

results.noEntitiesFound: No specific URLs, phone numbers, or UPI IDs detected.
results.toolOkTooltip: Passed verification checks without known threat flags.
results.toolWarnTooltip: Suspicious pattern, new registration, or unverified format detected.
results.toolErrorTooltip: Known malicious threat or phishing indicator confirmed.
results.toolSkippedTooltip: Verification check was skipped or not applicable.
